fixture.network_scope: Provider extension permission reviewed through the actual Extensions Console; explicit private/loopback permission; provider connection allow_private_ip=true and CIDR 127.0.0.1/32. No external or paid provider.

reproduction_steps: On the isolated Owner Console, activate the catalogued @tanpopo/openai-compatible adapter after reviewing the staged permission diff.
Create a project-scoped connection to the synthetic fixture on 127.0.0.1:19090, explicitly constrain CIDR to 127.0.0.1/32, classify as SELF_HOSTED_INFRA / ON_PREM, and live-probe it.
Create a zero-rate self-hosted deployment for qa005-model and a route qa005-playground-openai.
In Chromium Playground, select that route, set a 5,000,000 micro-USD session cap, submit a synthetic prompt, visually inspect the response and Execution traces card, then use Inspect trace.
Read the displayed trc_ identifier directly through GET /admin/v1/traces/{id}. Confirm persisted trace route, deployment, status, error, accuracy, cost and payload minimization.
Revoke all temporary Playground session Virtual Keys through Access & Keys; verify each state REVOKED/version 2.

classification.result: On this exact RC7 path, Playground displayed a trc_ identifier, performed direct trace lookups successfully, and Inspect trace opened the same persisted record; the historical req_/trc_ mismatch did not reproduce.
limitations: One Chromium Linux runtime, Owner, SQLite, OpenAI-compatible adapter, short SSE stream, and one synthetic model/route.
Other adapters, failed/canceled/long-running streams, Firefox/WebKit, roles, concurrent sessions, and persistence after browser restart remain UNVERIFIED.
This scoped pass does not erase historical failures or close DEF-017 globally.

exploratory_non_product_failures.status: PARTIAL exploratory setup failure; not classified as a product defect
exploratory_non_product_failures.case: Attempted Playground through the existing @tanpopo/ollama adapter but pointed it at the native Ollama fixture. Playground returned 502 upstream_malformed_response, persisted a trc_ trace (direct GET 200), and Inspect trace opened it. This fixture only serves native Ollama /api paths, while the test needed an OpenAI-compatible SSE endpoint. A protocol-matched OpenAI fixture and adapter subsequently passed.

Two Playground calls on the exhausted original project scope returned 429 project_budget_exceeded/Unsettled; both rendered trc_ identifiers, direct trace lookups returned 200, and Inspect trace resolved them. These requests exercised budget rejection; no provider inference occurred.
